items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: None of me, Buddy B. or Randy, or Chris Kelly, none of us played with them kind of bands. We always got our band up together.

ctx.x: But he wasn't a member of the Onward or the Excelsior or any of the old Tuxedo.

I'll tell you how most of this was like, if somebody would hire Buddy, well, he'd pick up his men, the men he wanted to play. But old Tuxedo and other bands like that, he never would play with them. None of me, Buddy B. or Randy, or Chris Kelly, none of us played with them kind of bands. We always got our band up together. But them fellas had their band had their number of men just wanted to buy it.
How many times did y'all work and say, a guy like Rene, a buddy, or you, would you work how many times a week in the street?
